comparison.objective: Scan four groceries exactly once and relay them to a bagging shelf; the candidate adjusts and locks an industrial gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2276 tests barcode-facing reorientation, occlusion avoidance, handoff, and varied-object transport; the candidate tests concentric tool use and torque-controlled setting retention.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2276 awards each item only for one decode and released shelf placement, with drop and unpaid-item failures; the candidate grades angle accuracy, locking, repeated motion, drift, retention, and clearance.
comparison.reason: The checkout task's tested ability is perception-guided item presentation and relay, not mechanical adjustment or countertorque.
